title: Solid omega beams
desc: Omega beams rebuilt as solid geometry with a bright core instead of particles; J: "the omega beams are very particle-y and hard to see".

takes.name: core + sheath
takes.facts: core r 0.045 (emission 4) inside a 45%-opaque sheath r 0.12 with two rim lines; fire at tick 10, reaches the wall 16 blocks away by 14 (4 blocks a tick), holds to 54 (+/-12% flicker), pulls back by 58; ring 5 > 10

takes.name: pulsing rings
takes.facts: same core and sheath with rings of light running down it, one every 3 ticks, each crossing in 6; fire at tick 10, reaches the wall 16 blocks away by 14 (4 blocks a tick), holds to 54 (+/-12% flicker), pulls back by 58; ring 5 > 10

takes.name: twin braid + sparks
takes.facts: two cores twisting round each other (r 0.07, one turn per 1.5 blocks), sheath, sparks off the wall every 2 ticks; fire at tick 10, reaches the wall 16 blocks away by 14 (4 blocks a tick), holds to 54 (+/-12% flicker), pulls back by 58; ring 5 > 10
